text:
Sam Chen: FYI enabling fp8 runtime kernels on canary pool (h100 & l40s) triggered a tiny but reproducible accuracy delta on atlas-13b prompt set. satprobe failing ~0.9% of prompts (ups from 0.1%).

canary-bot: [ALERT] fp8-canary h100-1: regression 0.9% vs baseline fp16 0.1% — details: satprobe_run/2026-03-19

Maria Lopez: which delta? perplexity or nlg exact-match?

Sam Chen: mostly exact-match / regex extraction tests (QA span). Perplexity shift small. Failing cases show trailing whitespace tokenization differences and one-off tokens near long prefixes.

Lee Park: @Sam can you paste minimal repro and the kernel build? different kernel versions between H100 and L40S?

Sam Chen: repro attached: prompt and seeds in `scripts/satprobe.sh`, kernel tags: h100: fp8-v2-tiling-20260315, l40s: fp8-v2-tiling-20260317 (slightly different tiling patch). Here's failing example:

[code]
PROMPT: "Given the contract in section 4.2, what is the termination clause?"
EXPECTED: "The termination clause is..."
MODEL: "...The termination clause is ." <-- extra space before period
[code]

Anil Gupta: interesting. we saw similar off-by-one exponent in earlier run where residual-scale handshake between layers used different pre-scaling on l40s. Could be scale clipping threshold.

Maria Lopez: any NaNs or saturation logs?

Sam Chen: no NaNs, but kernel trace shows several occurrences of values hitting 127 (8-bit exponent clamp?) — see trace snippet.

[code]
tile 42: max_abs=3.2e38 clamp_count=4
layer 17: pre_scale=1.2 post_scale=0.999
[code]

Lee Park: clamp_count is concerning. H100 kernel uses `autorange=true` by default; l40s build had `autorange=false` earlier maybe causing mismatch. Can we run with `autorange=false` on both to compare?

Sam Chen: did that — when forcing autorange=false across both, regression goes away but throughput drops ~6%. So handshake/auto scaling is likely the culprit.

Anil Gupta: hypothesis: autorange uses different bucketization/shift heuristics on the two kernels / different FP32->FP8 rounding (stochastic vs nearest). Confirm rounding mode?

Sam Chen: h100 build uses `stochastic_round=1`, l40s uses `stochastic_round=0` (oops). I think the handset default diverged after that tiling patch.

Maria Lopez: easy fix: align rounding mode and autorange heuristics, but we need per-layer canary to avoid perf regression. Plan:
- revert l40s kernel to stochastic_round=1 for canary pool (short-term)
- add unit test in satprobe to include long-prefix cases
- add telemetry: per-layer clamp_count, rounding_mode tag
- follow-up: implement bias-correction shim when switching rounding mode

Lee Park: create PR to set default rounding consistent. Also add rollout rule: disable fp8 for models with >0.5% satprobe delta.

Sam Chen: I'll open the PR and temp revert. Created issue INF-4823. Assign @Lee and @Anil to review.

canary-bot: deploy started: revert-l40s-stochastic-round -> canary pool (h100+l40s) 2367020200

Maria Lopez: thanks. Also add note to docs that enabling fp8 requires consistent autorange+rounding across backends.

Sam Chen: will add to runbook. :thumbsup:
